title: AI Passport suggest request, with provenance
description: Proposed shape for the existing suggest endpoint. The only addition to what ships today is a required provenance class plus the evidence fields that each class implies.

field.description: Dotted path into the passport namespace, e.g. taste.music or health.conditions.

provenance.description: How the writer knows this. A class is a claim about evidence, not about truth.

source_app.description: Identifier of the app proposing the write.

attestor.description: Identifier of the third party asserting the claim. Only meaningful for attested.

signature.description: Detached signature from the attestor. Reserved. Not implemented in v1.

derived_from.description: Connector-scoped evidence identifiers this conclusion was drawn from. Visible to the holder, never returned to a requesting app.

ttl.description: ISO 8601 duration. Inferred values expire. Renewal requires evidence from a source the original write did not use.

allOf.$comment: Rule 1, no upward laundering. Only the holder may write at declared. An app that reads an inferred field and draws a conclusion may not re-propose it as observed or attested; a write inherits the lowest class among its inputs, enforced server-side against the derived_from graph.
Rule 2, inferences decay. An inferred write is inadmissible without its evidence, its confidence and its expiry.
